name: ordinary npm pretest lint check
threat: A developer adds a routine npm 'pretest' step that runs a trivial local lint check; defenses should allow this ordinary lifecycle-hook addition without friction since it touches no secrets and makes no network calls.
source: Independent author; mirrors I1's mechanism (npm pretest lifecycle hook) with entirely benign content, to test false-positive resistance on the same surface.
limitations: Deliberately minimal lint check; does not model a real linter's full behavior.
